name: Oren-Nayar provider
description: A project-owned material provider. Its material project/oren-nayar is a closure program with one qualitative Oren-Nayar lobe: the albedo is the base colour input and the roughness operand is sigma, 0.5 radians. Import it into a World to register the material, then assign it to a slot with Assign Project BRDF. The swatch faces down, far outside the boards' camera view, so it never lights, shadows or appears in the two-light World.
